title: Aao Zindan Mei Roshni Ban Ker, Mere Baba Bara Andhera Hay
body:
Ub Na Roungee Baba Ko Bhaiyya, Apnay Zindan Mei Lay Chalo Mujhko
Mei Yahan Dar Say Mer Na Jaoun Kahien, Ghut Raha Dum Abhi Say Mera Hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Baheyn Sajjad Nay Chouraaeen Jub Apni Choti Behen Sakina Ki
Khoon Rothay Houay Kaha Bibi, Ub Mohaafiz Khuda Hee Tere Hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Qatl Baba Ka Daikha Bibi Nay Houee Qaidee Thamachay Bhi Khaaey
Char Salon Ki Zindagaani Mei Itnay Sudmon Nay Tujh Ko Ghayra Hay
<<DIVIDER>>
Thairee Beti Ko Neend Aati Nahien Aa Bhi Jaey Tho Kaan Dukh Thay Hain
Tere Seenay Pay Sothi Thi Baba, Ub Mera Khaaq Pay Baseyra Hay
